basic_info.description: Welcome home to 701 Minnesota #119! This ground level, loft style condo is a rarely available 1 bedroom - 1 bathroom home in one of the Dogpatch's most iconic brick warehouse conversions. Originally built in 1900 and reimagined in 1993, this award-winning community combines historic character with modern living. The loft features soaring ceilings, exposed brick, floor-to-ceiling windows with Hunter Douglas blinds, hardwood floors downstairs, carpet along the staircase & upstairs, recessed lighting, and an updated kitchen with granite counters and stainless appliances. A private patio opens to the landscaped courtyard with fountains, offering a peaceful retreat. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry and one car deeded parking. Located steps from Esprit Park, Crane Cove Park, local shops, cafes, and restaurants, with easy access to Caltrain, Muni, shuttles, and freeways 280/101. Don't miss this incredible opportunity to live in one of San Francisco's most progressive neighborhoods!
